newsitem.title: UK: BOXING-LEWIS'S TRAINER TURNS DOWN OFFER TO COACH TYSON.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-LEWIS'S TRAINER TURNS DOWN OFFER TO COACH TYSON.

text.p: The man who trains British heavyweight boxer Lennox Lewis has turned down an offer to switch to Mike Tyson's camp because he says the American is not good enough.

Emanuel Steward, Lewis's trainer for the past two years, said: "I turned Mike down without even bothering to ask how much money they were prepared to pay me. I have always been convinced Lennox is the best heavyweight out there and nothing could persuade me to turn my back on him.

"I suppose it is quite flattering to be asked by Mike to work with him," Steward acknowledged. "A lot of people believe that is the number one trainer's job in boxing but I had to tell him and his people I already have the top job."
The Tyson camp tried to poach Steward after the WBC champion was beaten by Evander Holyfield in November's WBA title bout.

"(Steward's decision) goes to prove Lewis has the best trainer in the world because Tyson went after him," Lewis's manager Frank Malony said on Wednesday. "And it proves to everyone Lennox is the best heavyweight in the world."
